relations: Harriot（叙述者）；Celia（伤者）；野猪；Eureka 医院（目标）
numbers: 伤口自九月未愈；至多几小时/午夜前；雪胎没有

facts.fact: 血：脏红褐漫在校长蛋壳缎上，来自你脚上磨散浸透的绷带；九月旧伤还是开放创口
她剥绷带：创口陷在脚掌、黄脓渗出、阴湿气味；她是医生的女儿——紧急、危及生命
facts.anchor: This was rapidly developing into an urgent, even life-threatening, issue.
facts.verbatim: This was rapidly developing into an urgent, even life-threatening, issue.

facts.fact: 「我们要去急诊」；她拖你穿衣；前门开着、跛过图书馆
facts.anchor: we’re going to the emergency room
facts.verbatim: we’re going to the emergency room

facts.fact: 「我们永远下不了山」「你忘了我是北方佬，雪地我能开」——连日雪与雨夹雪、脚下硬壳
facts.anchor: I can drive in the snow
facts.verbatim: I can drive in the snow

facts.fact: 车冻：门把几乎扯掉、从副驾跨过、钥匙终于转动；钟楼敲十二
facts.anchor: the bell tower began to chime twelve
facts.verbatim: the bell tower began to chime twelve

facts.fact: 山路陡降、浓雾；第一弯打滑冲向崖边，她 turn into the skid 救回；「这不是雪胎吧」「我忘了」
facts.anchor: I turned into the skid and saved it
facts.verbatim: I turned into the skid and saved it

facts.fact: 她把车滑下山坡（误算）；加速过快、雾更浓——巨大形状立在路中；你尖叫；她把车撞进树丛
野猪立在路中、看得见毛里的雪、转头看她们；「你现在看见了？」她按喇叭；你抓腕「别」
facts.anchor: The boar stood in the middle of the road.
facts.verbatim: The boar stood in the middle of the road.

facts.fact: 你眼钉后视镜、下巴颤「我看见它了」；她冷下来「你想让我以为是我的幻觉？为赢辩论？」
facts.anchor: You wanted me to think I was imagining things?
facts.verbatim: You wanted me to think I was imagining things?

facts.fact: 「我不能和你困在这里。若冻死，没人知道我在哪」；半埋雪沟、后胎悬空
facts.anchor: I can’t be trapped here with you.
facts.verbatim: I can’t be trapped here with you.

facts.fact: 她的承认是致命错误：现在无路可回、无路可出——「没有。路。可。出。」
